changeSet.author: tklok
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'queue' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResponsibilityIndex') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [queue].[ResponsibilityIndex]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetUID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Date] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueResponsibilityIndex_Date] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [BatchID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_QueueResponsibilityIndex_NumberOfRetries] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityIndex] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityIndex_BatchID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityIndex_BatchID] ON [queue].[ResponsibilityIndex] ( [BatchID] ASC ) INCLUDE([AssetUID]) END
